On Bool x Bool take independent fair latent type and assignment: half compliers with both potential outcomes 1 and half never-takers with both potential outcomes 1/2. The rejected candidate (0,0) is a point of the printed scalar system, not an asserted causal realization.

The full-compliance model in scratch/Check.lean realizes p=1,e0=0,e1=1. Interior examples are p=1/2,e0=e1=3/4 with both complier means t for any t in [1/2,1], and both never-taker potentials 3/2-t, independent fair assignment. Generally, for p<1 and treated coordinate x in its stated interval, use complier mass p with potentials (x-(e1-e0)/p,x) and never-taker mass 1-p with both potentials (e1-p*x)/(1-p); the interval guarantees every potential lies in [0,1]. At p=1 use only compliers with potentials (e0,e1).

It has p=1/3 and noncomplier mass 2/3, so every denominator in the corollary and its intermediate ratio is positive. Global potential integrability is automatic in this finite model.
